entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A red-aligned vulshok human geomancer from Mirrodin and former planeswalker who leads the Mirran resistance and loses his spark in the Great Desparkening.

entities.name: Echoverse Koth
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Koth, an Auriok steelfruit farmer whose spark never ignited, living in a peaceful Mirrodin.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior who fights beside Koth, later returning as an archangel.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An artificer who builds a planeshifting ship, is coerced to Mirrodin by Koth, and gives his life and spark to cure Karn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The golem creator of Mirrodin, corrupted by Phyrexian oil, then cured, and later imprisoned in the Seedcore.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran born without metal who is immune to phyresis and heals the infected.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: Elf leader of a band of Mirran rebels who enjoys his leadership position.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A traitorous artificer who gifts Melira to the companions and anonymously reports to Jace.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who intervenes when Elspeth attacks Koth.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who pursues the companions.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor who proposes an alliance because of his enmity with Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who gains influence across Mirrodin.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose Coliseum is in the Dross Pits.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor about to cut down Koth.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker infected with phyresis on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker found wounded and infected in Sheoldred's Coliseum.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrifices herself to blow up the Coliseum.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who tears Seven apart; Koth later helps remove Phyrexian metal from her body.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker aided by Koth and Urabrask in reaching Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanies Chandra to Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: A member of the rebel team torn apart by compleated Nissa.

entities.name: Kamath
entities.description: Koth's parent from the Hammer tribe.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Koth's homeland, conquered by Phyrexia and renamed New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mirran resistance
entities.description: The rebels fighting Phyrexia on Mirrodin, led by Koth.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: Koth's stony-armored people of the Oxidda Chain, divided into tribes.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders corrupting Mirrodin with phyresis.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A device the strike team carries to destroy Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A Phyrexian tree that opens paths between planes.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose consequences cost Koth his spark.

entities.name: Great Desparkening
entities.description: The event that faded Koth's spark.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: An alternate reality where Phyrexia never existed.

events.summary: Koth's planeswalker spark ignites as the tribes of his people fall into open war over corrupted ore.
events.quote: His planeswalker spark ignited when the tribes of his once peaceful people fell into open war for the first time in generations.

events.summary: Koth purifies the ore, restoring the metal and slowing the tribal skirmishes.
events.quote: Koth believed he could use his ability to purify the ore, and with Koth's help, the solidity of the metal was restored and the skirmishes between tribes slowed.

events.summary: Koth brands the Phyrexian insignia on his arm as a promise to save his people and begins planeswalking.
events.quote: he branded their insignia on his arm as a promise to his people to save them

events.summary: Koth fights Elspeth in the Urborg pits; she tries to kill him on seeing the Phyrexian mark until Ajani stops her.
events.quote: She was stopped by the timely intervention of Ajani Goldmane who had come looking for Elspeth.

events.summary: Koth, enraged by Venser's carelessness, encases his head in a stone mask to force him to Mirrodin.
events.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

events.summary: A Corrupted Harvester captures Venser and Koth, and Elspeth returns to help them escape.
events.quote: Venser and Koth fell quickly to a Corrupted Harvester and were dragged back to its lair near Ish Sah .

events.summary: The companions meet the rebel leader Ezuri, who backs down when threatened.
events.quote: But when Elspeth threatened Ezuri, and Venser displayed a bit of his magic, the elf backed down and his followers fled.

events.summary: Elspeth rages in Tezzeret's surgery room, and the companions free Melira, immune to phyresis.
events.quote: They freed Melira , a Mirran born without any metal on her body, from the cages.

events.summary: Melira heals the phyresis-infected in Ezuri's camp, then leaves with the companions.
events.quote: She healed all those in the camp that were infected by the glistening oil , healing non-stop for several days

events.summary: Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.
events.quote: With his last strength, Venser gave his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.

events.summary: Karn asks the group to lead the resistance with Melira.
events.quote: He asked them to begin organizing and leading the resistance with Melira to try to cleanse Mirrodin, no matter how long it would take.

events.summary: Elesh Norn gains influence, conquering Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains.
events.quote: Slowly, Elesh Norn gained more influence, even in the furnace layers, effectively conquering Urabrask 's and Sheoldred 's domains.

events.summary: Koth sinks Elspeth into the ground and shields her from the spellbomb blast so she can planeswalk away.
events.quote: He told her to go, but she did not budge, so he used his magic to sink her into the ground and create a shield against the blast, giving her only one option to escape.

events.summary: Koth is captured and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum, from which he escapes changed.
events.quote: He was sent to the Dross Pits and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum.

events.summary: Jace collapses from Halo and sets off after Vraska.
events.quote: Jace inexplicably reacted adversely to the potent elixir and collapsed.

events.summary: Vraska succumbs to Phyrexian influence and infects Jace.
events.quote: Lingering too long, Vraska succumbed to the Phyrexian influence and infected Jace in turn.

events.summary: Nahiri sacrifices herself, exploding the Coliseum onto the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: With a mighty magical blast, she exploded the Coliseum and dropped it with all remaining planeswalkers on the Fair Basilica .

events.summary: Koth finds Karn imprisoned in the Seedcore but must leave him.
events.quote: In the Seedcore, they met Karn imprisoned.

events.summary: Compleated Nissa tears Seven apart and the rebel team is captured.
events.quote: Here, they were stopped by the compleated Nissa Revane , who tore Seven apart limb from limb.

events.summary: A newly ascended Elspeth intervenes as Jin-Gitaxias is about to cut down Koth.
events.quote: Just as Jin-Gitaxias was to cut down Koth, a newly ascended Elspeth intervened, healing some of the Mirrans and giving them new resolve.

events.summary: Koth escapes with fewer than twenty Mirrans to Zhalfir.
events.quote: Koth was one of fewer than twenty surviving Mirrans able to escape and settle on Zhalfir .

events.summary: Koth's spark fades in the Great Desparkening.
events.quote: In the aftermath of the Invasion, Koth's spark faded due to The Great Desparkening .
